description.text: ObjectivesTo meet the needs of socialist society modernization, the postgraduates should attain the following objectives to be a senior talents developed morally, intellectually and physically in an all-round way.The post-graduates should meet the following objectives:1.Establishing the ideology of Patriotism and Collectivism and the scientific worldview and systematical methodology; mastering the fundamental principle of Dialectical Materialism and Historical Materialism; possessing both good professional ethics and scientific ethics; being well-behaved and physical and mental healthy2.Being equipped with a solidly basic theories and systematically specialized knowledge of the field of Business Administration to solve theoretical and practical problems in management field with proper operation of theory and method of management, information technology, systematical analyze method of qualitative and quantitative, and Corresponding engineering technology3 Have a rigorous Research attitude, good cooperation spirit and strong communication skills and life-long learning ability4 Master a foreign language, capable of reading the documents of this field, engaging in international communication and composing an academic paper5 Being physical and mental healthy

duration.text: The Accounting at Jiangsu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport (valid until after March 31, 2026). Those who have had experiences in China are required to provide all scanned copies of visas and residence permits related to China. (2) The original high school graduation certificate or a notarized copy is required. For current students, a pre-graduation certificate issued by the student's school (indicating the graduation date earlier than September 10, 2025) must be provided. During the registration and enrollment process, the original graduation certificate must be submitted. (3) Original copies or notarized versions of all course transcripts from the high school years; (4) Applicants for English-taught programs are required to provide copies of their IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo test scores. The IELTS score must be above 5.5, the TOEFL score must be above 80, or the Duolingo score must be above 100. (5) Self-introduction: Submit a self-introduction document expressing your intention to study in China (no less than 800 words). The document can be written in either Chinese or English. The content should include your personal learning and work experiences, your motivation for studying in China, reasons for choosing a specific major, and your personal career goals after graduation. (6) Foreign Physical Examination Form: Applicants are required to undergo the examinations as per the items listed in the form. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. (7) Financial Capacity Proof (One of the following documents: Family Deposit Certificate, Family Property Certificate, Parent/Guardian Income Certificate. It is recommended to be at least $5,000 or more.) (8) Criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months.

requirements.text: （1）Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a strong academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people. (2) Foreign citizens who have completed high school education or have equivalent qualifications and hold valid passports, aged between 18 and 25. Those under 18 years old must submit a guardianship guarantee letter. For those who were Chinese citizens originally and later acquired foreign nationality, the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education shall be followed.
